title: Remaining Vacancies in Secondary Schools following DSA Exercise and Affiliated Admissions
what_it_is: Remaining Vacancies in Secondary Schools following DSA Exercise and Affiliated Admissions

sections.label: Affiliated school reserved places
sections.summary: MOE requires affiliated secondary schools to reserve at least 20% of Secondary 1 places for non-affiliated students, applied to each posting group.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Since the 2019 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise, the Ministry of Education (MOE) has required affiliated secondary schools to reserve at least 20% of places of their Secondary 1 cohort for non-affiliated students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: This requirement is applied to each posting group, so that our schools remain open to students of different backgrounds.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Overall, over the past five years, non-affiliated students have comprised about half of the Secondary 1 cohort of affiliated secondary schools.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: The total number of Secondary 1 places offered in each school is the sum of planned places offered under the Secondary 1 Posting Exercise and the Direct School Admission (DSA) exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: While the DSA admissions does not reduce the number of Secondary 1 places available in a school, non-affiliated students admitted via the DSA exercise will be considered as taking up reserved places for non-affiliated students.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: In the past five years, there have been only two instances where an affiliated secondary school filled all the reserved places for non-affiliated students in one posting group via DSA, and no non-affiliated students were posted for that posting group during the Secondary 1 Posting Exercise.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Education (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: However, non-affiliated students in the other two posting groups were still admitted via the Secondary 1 Posting Exercise.

sections.label: Posting group score variance
sections.summary: The speaker asks about high variance, citing reports of differences up to 10 points within a posting group.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: Or it has a high variance in which case it is not so helpful for the family to make the decision this year.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim (Sengkang)
sentences.text: I ask this because I understand the principle behind wanting to encourage affiliated students to attend their given secondary school, but I have seen reports that this difference can be quite wide – as much as 10 points within the given posting group – which seems to undermine this principle of meritocracy.
